comments.author: Himesamanoyume
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the feedback. I’ll take some time soon to evaluate whether it’s feasible to add compatibility with ABPS. Regarding the commands, generally speaking, “On Your Own” and “Regroup” are two opposing orders. If you issue the “Regroup” command, your AI squadmates will stick with you at all times and won’t attempt to rush enemies—unless you switch them back to their default behavior using the “On Your Own” command.

However, I’m not exactly sure how you’re ordering your AI squadmates to return—are you using the “Go To” command? If so, then as I mentioned, switching to the “Regroup” command should resolve your issue. If not, it might indicate an unexpected bug in the command system.

You can disable the Mcs subtitles via the ConfigurationManager.

Mcs modifies AI behavior using the same underlying principles as SAIN. When SAIN is not installed, MCS relies entirely on its own layers. However, when SAIN is present, it utilizes a hybrid approach—combining Mcs layers with select SAIN layers, the latter of which are primarily dedicated to combat logic.

This is actually quite common in the mod ecosystem. Because many mods may patch the same function and modify the same execution flow.
